definition_quote.value: 'Practice of optometry' means 1 or more of the following, but does not include the performance of invasive procedures
definition_quote.quote: 'Practice of optometry' means 1 or more of the following, but does not include the performance of invasive procedures

value: examination of the human eye for defects or abnormal conditions
objective or subjective physical means to determine accommodative or refractive conditions or range of powers of vision or muscular equilibrium
adaptation or adjustment of lenses or prisms or use of therapeutic pharmaceutical agents
examination for contact lenses and fitting or insertion of contact lenses
use of diagnostic pharmaceutical agents (with certification)
methods_authorized.quote: The examination of the human eye to ascertain the presence of defects or abnormal conditions...The employment of objective or subjective physical means to determine the accommodative or refractive conditions...The adaptation or the adjustment of the lenses or prisms or the use of therapeutic pharmaceutical agents...The examination of the human eye for contact lenses and the fitting or insertion of contact lenses...The employment of objective or subjective means, including diagnostic pharmaceutical agents

drug_authority.value: Optometrists certified under section 17412 may administer diagnostic pharmaceutical agents (topical); those certified under section 17435 may administer and prescribe therapeutic pharmaceutical agents including topical prescription drugs, topical/oral antiglaucoma drugs, and oral drugs for anterior segment conditions and adnexa. Controlled substances in schedule 2 and oral cortical steroids are excluded; schedules 3, 4, and 5 controlled substances and dihydrocodeinone combination drugs are included.
drug_authority.quote: A licensee may administer and prescribe therapeutic pharmaceutical agents in the course of his or her practice if the licensee is certified by the board as being qualified to administer and prescribe therapeutic pharmaceutical agents pursuant to this section.

surgery_prohibited.quote: 'Practice of optometry' means 1 or more of the following, but does not include the performance of invasive procedures

surgery_definition.value: 'Invasive procedures' means: (i) the use of lasers other than for observation; (ii) the use of ionizing radiation; (iii) the use of therapeutic ultrasound; (iv) the administration of medication by injection; (v) procedures that include an incision.
surgery_definition.quote: "Invasive procedures" means all of the following: (i) The use of lasers other than for observation. (ii) The use of ionizing radiation. (iii) The use of therapeutic ultrasound. (iv) The administration of medication by injection. (v) Procedures that include an incision.

glaucoma_treatment_authorized.quote: A topically or orally administered antiglaucoma drug.

anaphylaxis_treatment_authorized.quote: The administration of medication by injection.

immunization_authority.quote: The administration of medication by injection.

value: Schedule 2 controlled substances are excluded from optometrists' drug authority
controlled_substance_schedule_restrictio.quote: does not include a controlled substance as defined in section 7104 and included in schedule 2 under section 7214, an oral cortical steroid, or a prescription drug. However, drug does include a controlled substance included in schedules 3, 4, and 5

oral_pharmaceutical_authority.quote: An orally administered prescription drug or other orally administered drug used for the purpose of investigating, analyzing, diagnosing, correcting, remedying, or relieving a defect or abnormal condition of the anterior segment of the human eye and adnexa

pharmaceutical_certification_required.quote: A licensee may administer and prescribe therapeutic pharmaceutical agents in the course of his or her practice if the licensee is certified by the board as being qualified to administer and prescribe therapeutic pharmaceutical agents pursuant to this section.

referral_to_physician_required.quote: if an optometrist determines from interviewing or examining a patient...that there are present in that patient signs or symptoms that may be evidence of disease that the optometrist is not authorized to treat under this part, then the optometrist shall...Promptly advise that patient to seek evaluation by an appropriate physician for diagnosis and possible treatment.

comanagement_with_ophthalmologist_requir.quote: When a diagnosis of glaucoma is made and treatment has begun, the treating optometrist shall consult an appropriate physician for further diagnosis and possible treatment if the condition does not demonstrate adequate clinical progress as a result of the treatment.
